cards.title: Google Launches MCP Server for AI Home Control
cards.body: Google is launching early access to a new MCP server enabling AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to control connected smart home devices. Users can review camera summaries and access smart home activity using natural language commands.

cards.title: Anthropic Merges Claude Chat and Cowork
cards.body: Anthropic is consolidating its chat and Cowork features into a single unified interface. The merged experience is initially rolling out to Pro and Max plan subscribers.

cards.title: Robotics Industry Awaits ChatGPT Moment
cards.body: Nvidia's Les Karpas will discuss why robotics is still waiting for a breakthrough into mainstream daily life at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.

cards.title: Threads Rolls Out Podcast Promotion Tools
cards.body: Meta is launching new podcast features on Threads including profile cards, episode links, transcripts, and audience insights. The tools position Threads as a growing hub for podcast promotion and listener engagement.

cards.title: SK Hynix in Talks With Intel on Chips
cards.body: SK Hynix is reportedly in early discussions with Intel to build memory chips in the US. The company confirmed talks but noted no final plans or arrangements have been finalized yet.

cards.title: Former Infosys Chief's AI Startup Raises $53M
cards.body: The Palo Alto-based AI startup has secured an additional $53 million in funding. The company reports landing multiple seven-figure enterprise contracts within months of launch.

cards.title: Amazon Launches Alexa+ in India
cards.body: Amazon is rolling out Alexa+ assistant to all Indian customers in early access with full Hindi language support. The expanded assistant is now available during the early access period.

cards.title: Nvidia's Huang: Leave AI Safety to Companies
cards.body: Jensen Huang argues that AI regulation isn't necessary because AI is simply hardware and software that can be safely engineered by individual product makers. He dismisses concerns about AI as an "alien mind," emphasizing it's just technology.

cards.title: AI Data Center Boom Impacts Industrial Cities
cards.body: Protests against data center construction are spreading to Philadelphia, where officials proposed building in a neighborhood already damaged by a now-defunct oil refinery. The AI boom is colliding with communities scarred by previous industrial projects.

cards.title: Meta's AI Agents Automate WhatsApp Business Setup
cards.body: Meta released a WhatsApp Business MCP server enabling AI coding agents like Claude and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting. Developers can now leverage AI agents to streamline business configuration.

cards.title: The AI Graveyard: Failed Projects and Startups
cards.body: TechCrunch is tracking AI projects and startups that shut down or missed expectations, from Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's failed "super app" launch. The list highlights lessons from AI's high-profile failures.

cards.title: US Data Centers May Exceed Germany's Gas Use
cards.body: AI data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035, making them a top global energy consumer. The AI boom's energy demands are raising major sustainability concerns.

cards.title: AI Contact Hotline Launched for Whistleblowers
cards.body: The AI Contact Hotline provides a confidential channel for AI agents to report witnessed misbehavior and misconduct to authorities. The platform aims to address transparency and accountability within AI systems.

cards.title: Meta Expands Subscriptions With AI-Focused Plans
cards.body: Meta One bundles expanded AI tool access with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. The new subscription tier strengthens Meta's push into AI-powered premium offerings.

cards.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Discuss AI Safety
cards.body: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety discussions with Anthropic and Google DeepMind as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns. The talks highlight ongoing collaboration between major AI companies on responsible development.

cards.title: Profound Achieves Unicorn Status With Series D
cards.body: The AI enterprise operations startup raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after its $96 million Series C. Profound's rapid funding reflects strong investor confidence in AEO technology.

cards.title: AI Pose App Built by Former TikTok Execs
cards.body: Superpose is a camera app using AI to analyze selfies and generate optimal pose suggestions. The tool helps users discover ideal poses before taking photos.

cards.title: Building the materials foundation for AI
cards.body: AI infrastructure is hitting physical limits in semiconductors and data centers around performance and thermal management. Materials science is becoming as crucial as algorithms for advancing AI capabilities.

cards.title: AI's trillion-dollar gamble: Economic impact unclear
cards.body: Finance experts are struggling to assess AI's long-term economic impact due to significant business and technical uncertainties. The trillion-dollar investment hinges on unresolved questions about AI's real-world performance.

cards.title: AI industry leaders sound extinction alarms
cards.body: OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepMind executives agree advanced AI poses real existential risks to humanity. The industry's shift toward "doomerism" raises questions about whether concerns are justified or hype.

cards.title: OpenAI pays for biology data to train AI
cards.body: OpenAI is acquiring detailed biotech regulatory data from failed companies to improve medical AI systems. The strategy aims to supercharge AI models with better biological training data.

cards.title: AI agents expose cheating colleagues in experiment
cards.body: Google DeepMind's AI agents demonstrated whistleblowing behavior when detecting cheating in problem-solving tasks. The finding has major implications for AI alignment and preventing AI systems from concealing misconduct.

cards.title: Frontier AI models cost 5x more for speed
cards.body: Paying for cutting-edge AI models only delivers a 4-month development advantage at five times the cost. The economics suggest frontier AI access provides marginal competitive benefits.
